faq.question: What is Forró?
faq.answer: Forró is a family of partner dances from northeastern Brazil, danced to lively music featuring accordion, zabumba drum, and triangle. It's joyful, social, and easy to pick up — most people are dancing by the end of their first class.

faq.question: Do I need a partner to come?
faq.answer: No partner needed! Forró is danced in a rotating partner format at socials, so you'll dance with many different people throughout the evening. Everyone is welcome to come alone.

faq.question: I've never danced before. Can I come to a social?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Forró socials in Berlin are relaxed and welcoming. If you're brand new, we recommend a beginner class first — but you're always welcome to just show up and watch, then jump in when you feel ready.

faq.question: What is the code of conduct?
faq.answer: Forró is a consent-based dance. Always ask before dancing, accept a 'no' graciously, and respect your partner's comfort. Our community is built on trust and inclusion — harassment of any kind is not tolerated.

faq.question: Where can I find regular classes in Berlin?
faq.answer: Several organizers run weekly classes across the city. Check the Events section above for the current schedule. Classes are typically grouped by level: beginner, improver, and intermediate/advanced.
